# Checkpoint shard headers

Real safetensors headers, gzipped, shared by `crates/safetensors/src/lib.rs`'s folder tests and the checkpoint configuration tests in this crate. Each `.header.json.gz` is the JSON header of one shard exactly as the file stores it (the bytes after its 8-byte length), read by an HTTP range request. The tests write each one as a shard whose data section is a hole, so the files have the real layout and no tensor bytes.

Both name the same 401 `quantized_layers` (193 NVFP4 of group 16: the 64 x 3 feed-forward projections and `lm_head`; 208 FP8: the 48 x 3 `linear_attn` and 16 x 4 `self_attn` projections) and the exclusion `mtp*`, `mtp.layers.0*` (`config.json` spells it `ignore`, the file `exclude_modules`) |
| `qwen3.8-27b-nvfp4-layers-0-3.tensors.json.gz` | the same repo and revision: the dtype and shape of every tensor of layers 0 (gated delta rule) and 3 (attention) and every unlayered tensor (`model.language_model.embed_tokens`, `model.language_model.norm`, `lm_head` with its block scale, tensor scale and input scale, the vision tower's 333 `model.visual.` tensors and the next-token layer's 15 `mtp.` tensors), 411 in all, read by HTTP range request from the headers of shards 1 and 3 of the 3 (shard 2's header was read to compare). The index lists 2,194 tensors, and every layer of a kind holds the names, dtypes and shapes of its committed layer (compared key by key over all three headers): 48 x 29 + 16 x 28 + 354 = 2,194. An FP8 weight is `F8_E4M3` with a `weight_scale` and an `input_scale`, each F32 of no dimension; an NVFP4 weight is `U8` `[rows, k / 2]` with an `F8_E4M3` `weight_scale` `[rows, k / 16]` and F32 `weight_scale_2` and `input_scale` of no dimension; the gammas, the embedding, `in_proj_a`, `in_proj_b`, the taps (`[channels, 1, 4]`) and the vectors are BF16 |
